name: codex-multi-model-skills
description: Run selectable model APIs in parallel, either synthesize immediately or discuss before a configurable synthesizer produces the final answer.

interface.longDescription: Includes two Codex skills: one asks GPT 5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8 Max, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM 5.2, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Deep Think for independent answers and synthesizes immediately; the other adds a discussion/revision round before GPT 5.5 Pro produces the final answer.
